import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_73/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_73/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on 'city' as per operation history
df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Ensure columns are in target schema order and types:
# Target schema: ['type': string, 'city': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': float, 'driver_count': integer]

# Convert types explicitly
df['type'] = df['type'].astype(str)
df['city'] = df['city'].astype(str)
df['fare'] = df['fare'].astype(float)
df['ride_id'] = df['ride_id'].astype(float)
df['driver_count'] = df['driver_count'].astype(int)

# Select only the target columns in order
target_df = df[['type', 'city', 'fare', 'ride_id', 'driver_count']]

# Write to the target path without index
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_73/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_73/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_73/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'city' (primary key), aggregate other columns accordingly:
# - 'type' and 'driver_count' are categorical/integer, take first (all same per city due to FD)
# - 'fare' and 'ride_id' are numeric, take mean to aggregate multiple rides per city
result = joined.groupby("city", as_index=False).agg({
    "type": "first",
    "fare": "mean",
    "ride_id": "mean",
    "driver_count": "first"
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
result = result[["type", "city", "fare", "ride_id", "driver_count"]]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_73/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
